worktree.doc: the lane worktree (a rebase merge rebases there; the merge itself runs in its own merge worktree)

notes.doc: the MERGE NOTES file (durable, outside every worktree)

ui.doc: non-empty = the branch changes the dash / UI (the merge takes shots per policy.merge.shots)

sha.doc: a tested commit: the staged merge of that commit (norn merge-brief --sha); every merge works in its own merge worktree

after.doc: after terms the merge waits for, e.g. run:RUN-n:done (empty = merge now)
